data.name: Void Runner
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the Void.

The Void waits for no one. Pilot your ship through minimal arenas, dodge waves of dynamically generated enemies, and shape — run after run — the build that takes you further. VOID RUNNER is a precision-tuned arcade roguelite: every death teaches you something, every score on the global Top 10 dares you to surpass it.

Inspired by bullet hells, twin-stick shooters, and modern roguelites, VOID RUNNER stakes everything on mastery. Each run starts from zero: pick your skills between waves, adapt to dynamically generated enemies, manage fatigue and scoreboard pressure. The meta-upgrades of Infinite Mode persist, letting you push further and further — if you have it in you. How far will you go?

Features

  • 5 worlds, 30+ hand-crafted levels — Dark Void, Silent Death, Pink Abyss, Blink Mode, Green Lava. Each with its own enemies, atmosphere, and challenges.
  • Infinite Mode with persistent meta-upgrades. Wave after wave, endless, all the way to the Inferno W50+ and beyond.
  • 28 unlockable skills with a T1–T5 evolution tree — multi-shot, taser, Nexus drone, frost, poison, vamp, execute, and more.
  • Leaderboards — global per world + local Top 10. Test your skill, defend your record.
  • Original 8-bit soundtrack composed by VeryBadMusic. Each world has its own track, and the Void's soundtrack follows you in Infinite.
  • Deep accessibility — Discovery Mode (HP +30%, slowed enemies), high-contrast mode, colorblind mode (proto/deutero/trito), photosensitivity warning at launch, on-screen intensity controls.
  • Full Steam integration — Cloud Save, 20 achievements, Shift+Tab overlay.
  • Steam Deck friendly — graphics preset optimized for Valve's hardware.
  • 9 languages: EN, FR, DE, ES, IT, AR, ZH, JA, HI.
  • All input devices — keyboard+mouse, Xbox/PS controller, Steam Deck native.

Game modes

  • Campaign — 5 unique worlds, pure score-attack. No meta-progression: only your skill decides.
  • Infinite — endless waves, persistent meta-upgrades. Reach the Inferno, then prove you can hold it.
  • Discovery Mode — tame the Void without getting wrecked (HP +30%, slowed enemies, scores not submitted to leaderboards).
  • Tutorial — learn the mechanics without pressure.

    Early Access

    VOID RUNNER is in Early Access: the foundation is solid and playable end-to-end, but the Void still hides secrets. Coming in the months ahead:
    • New bosses with unique mechanics
    • New worlds to explore
    • New skills and T6+ evolutions
    • New music tracks
    • Whatever the community asks for next

    Your feedback shapes the game. The Void doesn't fill itself. Are you up to the challenge?

data.short_description: Dive into the Void. Dodge, fire, restart. Sharpen your build run after run and claim a spot on the global Top 10. A pure, demanding arcade roguelite: 28 evolving skills, 5 hand-crafted worlds or endless survival. Your skill, your ladder.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD equivalent (no dedicated GPU required, 2D Canvas)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Native gamepad + keyboard + mouse + touch supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz (Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Vega 8 (for smooth 60 FPS in late-game waves)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Steam Deck Verified compatible

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3 / Debian 11+ / Fedora 36+ (glibc 2.31+)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD APU integrated (no dedicated GPU required)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible
  • Additional Notes: AppImage format. Steam Deck supported.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04+ / SteamOS 3
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / AMD Vega 8 (Steam Deck APU OK)
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Steam Deck Verified compatible
